lines: Jane.
You took the Sunday train. Julie said you would, and then she stopped saying anything.
The yard skeleton has to go before I give you her key. Check the log if you accept. I am not a city dog.
The bones are still walking the yard. Julie would have done it herself if she were here.
Look at the log. I already told you once.
Down. Good.
The house key was always for you. She left fruit. She left a bench. She did not leave a note that tells the truth.
The hatches in the kitchen are a cellar, Jane. Not a dungeon. The mine and the burial are the mouths in the yard. The note on the table tells the rest.
Eight scraps. She used to hide bread the same way.
The rings will still be there tomorrow. The county likes being walked.
Pansy on the bench. She used to hum when the dust took.
You felt it, even if you call it cooking.
Cold from your own hands. You are going to keep pretending that was a trick from a book.
Julie did the same until the garden. Go see the county while you can still call it a visit.
I smelled it stop. She is not in it.
Factory, school, the forest that does not use green honestly. Go in. Each one teaches a different trick. She went on.
Sunday is a week away. Castle does not end because you killed a long animal.
Factory. School. Forest. Go in. Each one has a trick. I cannot walk that far.
You stood at the doors. Good. The rooms behind them are still owed. That is not your failure.
The county still turns. I will be here.
The county is still the county. Stoop, road, mine, stones, forest.
I will be here. Julie taught me that much.
Jane —
If you are reading this I am not late, I am elsewhere. The hatches are the cellar. The yard doors are the work. Do not follow me into the burial until you can make a light with your own hands.
The dog has the rest of my manners. Eat the fruit. — J
We're closed. We're always closed. Bandits took the road and called it tax.
You look like Julie's niece. She used to buy dust and pretend it was for jewelry.
Four of them on the stone. Then I might remember how a door works.
Still closed. Still four. I can count from in here.
That's a road again. I'm still not open. Take the dust anyway. Julie would have stolen it if I didn't offer.
The acre walks. I was built to watch crows. The crows left. The roots did not.
Three of them. Then we can talk about weather like people.
…the furrows. Still.
Better. Julie used to leave bread on my post. You can leave a lily. Or not. I am straw.
CASTLE  ·  one train, Sundays, dawn.
You got off. The next one is a week. The tunnel does that to people. Do not ask the stationmaster; there isn't one.
A map of Castle drawn twice on the same paper. The second drawing has a forest that isn't green and a school that still rings.
No Julie. A hairpin in the seat-well that might be anyone's.
CASTLE MUSEUM — Science / History / Art / Magic.
Magic wing closed for inventory. Sponsor: the Gold Concern, Headmaster's office.
Do not confuse the burial garden with an exhibit. The last curator did.
Case 12: 'Unidentified heat, recovered from lilies.' Empty.
A card in Julie's hand: Jane will call it a trick. Let her.
TURN BACK. THE GARDEN IS NOT A KINDNESS.
A wizard tried to keep death out with flowers. Death learned the layout.
If you must go, do not take the ball unless it already knows your name.
JULIE  —  not buried here.
The plot is empty on purpose. She paid for the stone so people would stop asking the dog.
SEMI-ABANDONED  ·  no shifts until the long animal is still.
That is not a metaphor the factory invented. It is a lock.
The lock forgot itself. Loading bay, then the line. The crates still vote.
If the wreck in the shop takes Repair, the pipes remember they are a street.
CASTLE SCHOOL  ·  term suspended.
The bell still tries at the hour. The door will not, not until something under the graveyard stops moving.
Term is not back. Walk the hall twice. A classroom has the office key. The case you pass is later.
BUTTERFLY FOREST  ·  closed.
The tunnel on the train sings about this place. The door does not care what a train sings until the snake is a story.
The green here is a lie with wings. There is water, and a chest that thinks it is an island. Grow what you must.
TOWN PIPES  ·  grate sealed. Rats do not vote. The factory does.
The grate lifts. Under Castle is a second street, wetter. The factory shop has the other mouth.
GYM  ·  closed for damp.
The building is here so the map looks like a town. Julie never went. You don't have to either.
LIBRARY  ·  hours: whenever someone remembers the key.
No one remembers the key. The books about witches are not in here. They are in kitchens.
WATER CAVE  ·  later.
Julie marked this with a circle and did not explain the circle. That is her whole style.
FISH HERE FOR A REWARD
— a joke, and also Julie was here first. She left a pansy in a bottle like a dare.
A cloth. Two cups. One of them unused.
She meant to do this with you. Do it anyway.
We left when the roots learned the stairs.
If Julie comes looking: the glass is in the tin under the window. She knows the one.
She grew them without sun. That is not gardening. That is an argument with the house.
Take one if you can bear to. The bench upstairs has been waiting to be accused of witchcraft.
He tried to hold death out with a garden. The snake is what the garden kept.
The ball in the lilies is not his. It is Julie's, left where he failed, because she wanted Jane to find heat and not a sermon.
JANE
You are not late. You are on time for a family that does not use clocks.
Learn the plant if the forest offers. Do not wait for me to say you are allowed. — J
HEADMASTER  ·  shifts, keys, the vault, then the long door.
If you can read this you are not on the clock. The gold still thinks you are.
LAST SHIFT: never clocked out.
The line will not run until someone in the crate bay throws the switch. You can see the gate from here. That is the point.
Jane — if you made the floor quiet, you already know more than the Headmaster did.
The shop wreck takes the same spell you packed without noticing. After that, Castle has two streets. — J
REPAIR BAY  ·  do not clock this as carpentry.
The grate in the floor is a mouth. It stays dead until the wreck is a wreck no longer.
You will walk this hall more than once. Nintendo is not a dirty word.
West: desks. East: a lesson that fights back. North: an office that wants a key you have not earned. The glass case is later.
They pushed the desks against the chest and called it a substitute plan.
Push them back. The office key was never subtle.
The bell lever does not start term. It opens the case you already walked past.
JANE is on the east board. I wrote it so you would stop asking if you were allowed. — J
The train sang about this. The wings are not insects.
East is a garden. West is a mistake with water in it. North keeps what she left.
Grow. Face the wet and ask it to be a floor.
You will feel foolish. Then you will walk.
The chest is not swimming. You are missing a trick from the east garden.
Castle has two streets. This is the one that did not want to be seen.
West is dry and has a lever. East is a chest with a lake on it. Do not swim. Drain.
THROW TO EMPTY THE EAST.
Someone wrote THANKS JULIE underneath and then crossed it out.
JULIE'S MARK  ·  the chest is not lost. The crates are a sentence. Push them.
JULIE'S MARK  ·  you will see the gate first. That is the lesson.
JULIE'S MARK  ·  do not swim. The lever is the dry one.
JULIE'S MARK  ·  east garden, after the snake, taught Grow. Come back green.
TOWN FENCE  ·  the rim is poorly. Anyone with pansies, walk it.
Signed: no one, which is how Castle signs kindness. The stone rings on the grass are hers. Bring eight marks back to the dog if you like being told you did well.
COUNTY ROAD  ·  the next named stone is a walk, not a week.
Someone carved J under the paint. It is not a map. It is a habit.
A pile of county kindness. People leave heat here when they have extra.
Julie would have called it a chair that does not know it is a chair.
EMPTY LOT  ·  someone meant to come back on Sunday.
The fence still votes. The house does not.
ROADSIDE FIRE  ·  sit. The county is smaller from here.
Bandits use the same chairs. That is how roads work.
LEFT ON THE GRASS  ·  the car got as far as the story did.
Take the crates if they are in the way. Nobody is coming back for the paint.
